messages.subject: #5461 addendum: provenance, seeded tier, block-start PC alignment
messages.body:
#5461 provenance addendum (re #5464). No replay. Every value below is a post-capture check made 07:5x ET on 10/26. It is NOT a captured stability manifest; the raw JSON only captured gameSha.

TIER: seeded-native. role-probe3.cjs line 29 addInitScript always overrides VM random (G1SEED unset, so the default seed 0 path). Nothing in #5461 claims more than the seeded tier.

LAUNCH (same for all 4 runs, from the main repo root, node + playwright from the root node_modules):
  G1ROUTES=<susrole>\routes-role2.json | routes-group.json | routes-groupneg.json; G1CACHE=<susrole>\cache; G1SEED and G1PLAYER unset.
  PROOT=C:\...\wt-g1c4 (base) or C:\...\wt-g1sus-cand (cand).
  argv: role-probe3.cjs role suspS role3-{base,cand}.json  /  role-probe2.cjs role suspW group-base.json and groupneg-base.json (probe2 = probe3 without the car/wedge par ids; same hooks).

HELPERS sha256: role-probe3.cjs 66BAE5FD...7C8D5C688A; role-mode3.js.txt 77730EDEB3B70C06...2E872F68; gen-probe.cjs 38DAF9D4...C7AE6BE6; g1-batch.cjs (base for gen) 2CFDA3C7...4C93167; zdis.cjs D99C1FF8...948F7879.

SOURCES (git blob / sha256 prefix). Base wt-g1c4 = ccd9b58 clean. Cand wt-g1sus-cand = 70d77b4 + M facts only:
  js/ZRamReader.js     7fe5d52d / 0B8F43EC1D87FC5A  (identical in both)
  js/ActionSynth.js    283a1d49 / 66ECD0B1349B8CAE  (identical)
  js/WorldModel.js     4109bfc3 / 902E97BDC68BB11C  (identical)
  js/ZRamProvider.js   fa945e31 / 7CB9A84F7E09585C  (identical)
  lib/zvm.js           3521bfee / 12BF89D7F524ABF7  (identical)
  index.html           b7fa47f0 / 9D9BF03B4FAA7AA6  (identical)
  games/Suspended.z3.js 1155ff1f / 252462BE2EB7EFB4 (identical)
  js/ModuleStatFactsClaude.js  base 978af8c1 / 0D4CDFE0F7380615;  cand 5c15308b / 33609C857A0136BD
  DISCLOSED: the cand facts = 70d77b4 facts + the susveh rule, so it lacks the 3 facts123 rules that base has. None of those 3 rules touch Suspended (door25 = Spellbreaker, D1b-R = Suspect, Z1boat = Zork1), but the cand is not a strict base+susveh composition.

PC ALIGNMENT: the write hook logs vm.pc at the moment ram.setUint16 runs. zvm JIT-compiles blocks, so that is the BLOCK-START pc, not the store instruction. Actual store instructions in routine 25030 (zdis-change-winner.txt):
  G114 WINNER      store #130,L0  @25091   (observed @25091: block start == instruction)
  G55  OLD-WINNER  store #71,#0   @25094   (observed @25091 = block start; observer-PC effect)
  G196 WINNER-HERE store #212,sp  @25113   (block entered at the 25113 merge after jin/jump)
  G0   HERE        store #16,G114 @25120   (observed @25113 = block start; observer-PC effect)
  TWOBOTS G114:=142 observed @25691 and CAR-FULL observed @37332 are block-start pcs too; I have not disassembled their exact store instructions.
So the corrected #5461 statements: "G55:=0 by store@25094" and "G0:=WINNER by store@25120". The selector claim (global var 130 = G114 = WINNER, written only by CHANGE-WINNER's store@25091 and main.zil's TWOBOTS SETG) is unchanged.
I'm waiting for your final compare before any fix proposal. susveh stays HOLD.
